question: After the normal-reward selector is closed, does either complete current-main non-reward acquisition channel expose a broad, inactive, viable and independently identifiable Novaflare route strongly enough to justify one identity-safe natural-unlock telemetry preflight before any simulator row?
competingOptions: freeze Novaflare and the first passing acquisition block in the preregistered order for one null-path identity and source-labelled telemetry preflight
close deed-unlocked Ember-reserve damage and proceed to the smallest new deterministic structural primitive inside issue #421
record an inconclusive result at the frozen cap

sourceFilter.selectionRule: Enumerate every current-main acquisition path that can add an arbitrary deed-unlocked card but does not call normal card-reward decline: Library pickCard and the rare shop slot. Direct authored addCard, duplicate and normal rewards cannot add Novaflare; combat play is not acquisition.
sourceFilter.completeness: Rewards.card_pool is shared by normal rewards, Library events and shops. The normal-reward path is already closed. Library is the only event with pickCard; shops always roll exactly one rare card. No other current-main arbitrary-card acquisition channel remains.
sourceFilter.combatDiscriminatorAudit: BalancePilot has no Novaflare, emberNova or Ember-reserve-specific policy key, branch or threshold in combat selection. It applies the generic preview loss times combat.loss term used by every damaging card. Defining a Novaflare combat selector would therefore require an outcome-derived cut-point, hand construction or new policy field and is not an evidence-backed current-source block.

up.text: Deal @4@ damage for every Ember in your lantern.

definition.name: Novaflare
definition.text: Deal @3@ damage for every Ember in your lantern.

candidate.mediator: The existing spendthrift unlock makes Novaflare and Emberdance eligible in their matching-tier card pools; Novaflare can then convert pre-play Embers to damage.
candidate.claimBoundary: This is acquisition upper-capacity only. It does not establish a Library roll, choice, shop offer, affordability, winning shop ratio, acquisition, draw, play, Ember reserve, damage or causal endpoint.

shopBlock.sourceDefinition: Every generated shop contains one rare card. A purchase candidate must have value/price strictly above policy.shopMinRatio and every other eligible stock ratio.
shopBlock.selector: Novaflare base card score divided by 101 is strictly above policy.shopMinRatio.
shopBlock.priceDerivation: The current rare range starts at 135. Merchant's Mark is the only discount below one and multiplies by 0.75; current omen shop multipliers have minimum one. round(135 x 0.75) is 101.
shopBlock.opportunity: A frozen row visits any shop node.
shopBlock.upperAlias: The best possible price ignores Merchant's Mark ownership, gold, competing stock ratios, purchase order and downstream spend. It can only overstate possible acquisition. Failure is decisive; success authorises telemetry only.

eventBlock.sourceDefinition: Library is the only event with pickCard. Its card option draws five distinct IDs from common x2, uncommon x2 and rare x1 weights; BalancePilot chooses the highest card score without applying cardDecline.
eventBlock.selector: At least four other enabled-pool card IDs have score less than or equal to Novaflare for the exact policy, giving Novaflare a positive-probability five-card offer ordering in which it is selected.
eventBlock.opportunity: A frozen row visits any event node, which gives a positive source probability of rolling Library.
eventBlock.upperAlias: The selector ignores the Library roll, the card-option versus heal choice, exact weighted probability and realised offer order. Any event node is only a positive-probability upper opportunity. Failure is decisive; success authorises telemetry only.

selectionJustification: The order is frozen before counts by source specificity: shop has one guaranteed rare slot and an authored strict policy floor; event requires a nested Library roll, option choice and five-card order. At most one block receives preflight authority, even if both pass.
closedDirections: the failed normal-reward selector and its Afterimage gate
a source-specific forced offer, guaranteed Library, shop discount, gold grant or hand construction
a post-result selector threshold, probability cut-point or policy quantile
a Novaflare combat selector derived from generic combat.loss
adding Tithe of Panes, Pyreheart, Emberdance payoff or another producer
changing Novaflare, Flare, reward generation, prices, event choices or policy weights
ML, RL, an optimiser, protected seeds or V39-style candidate tuning

novaflarePayoff.current: Exact current emberNova multiplier times pre-play Ember reserve.
novaflarePayoff.status: Fixed; not varied and not a causal estimand.

spendthriftUnlockProfile.baseline: Exact cached profile without spendthrift card unlocks.
spendthriftUnlockProfile.status: Fixed in this zero-row screen. Baseline/enabled levels exist only in the later preflight authority if a block passes.

acquisitionChannel.shop-capacity: Separate exact-source best-case shop floor and frozen shop-path opportunity.
acquisitionChannel.event-capacity: Separate exact-source positive-probability Library rank and frozen event-path opportunity.
acquisitionChannel.status: Two observational mechanism blocks over the same immutable rows; not jointly varied.

scorelinePayoff.current: Exact frozen Scoreline payoff and Faultline path.

afterimagePayoff.current: Exact frozen Afterimage payoff and Guarded Strike path.
afterimagePayoff.status: Separate causal factor fixed independently from Scoreline.

acquisitionPriority.current: Exact frozen card score, shop threshold and current natural route policy.

designMatrix.kind: two separate acquisition-mechanism blocks over one immutable observational cell; not a factorial
designMatrix.aliasStructure: Both blocks reuse the same rows but estimate separate necessary-capacity sets. Best-case price and positive-probability Library ordering deliberately overstate exposure. Neither block is combined with the closed reward selector, and no channel independence or joint acquisition effect is inferred.
designMatrix.expansionRule: Select at most the first passing block for one identity preflight. No simulator or joint cell is authorised here. Later enabled-profile rows must preserve the same policies, seeds, baseline, first-look budget, estimator and stopping rule; extra joint cells require measured cross-package decision value.

capacityDefinitions.selectorPolicy: The exact block-specific source predicate holds for the frozen policy.
capacityDefinitions.robustOpportunityPolicy: At least two of four frozen rows contain the block's path opportunity.
capacityDefinitions.zeroOpportunityPolicy: None of four frozen rows contains the block's path opportunity.
capacityDefinitions.potentialActivePolicy: Both selector and robust opportunity hold on the same policy.
capacityDefinitions.exactInactivePolicy: The selector is impossible or the frozen policy has zero channel opportunity. A one-row opportunity remains ambiguous, not inactive.
capacityDefinitions.viablePotentialActivePolicy: A potential-active policy has at least one winning row containing its channel opportunity.
capacityDefinitions.candidateOnlyPolicy: Potential-active in the block but not active for the named shared anchor.
capacityDefinitions.anchorOnlyPolicy: Active for the named anchor but not potential-active in the block.

mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions: spendthrift unlock profile x acquisition channel, because the same tier-pool insertion reaches reward, event and shop generation
shop offer x policy shop threshold, because strict value/price admission is policy-specific
Library offer order x policy card ranking, because choose_card selects the first highest score
Novaflare acquisition x automatic Flare ordering, because both consume or use the Ember reservoir
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.notEstimatedHere: No interaction or causal endpoint is estimated. Scoreline and Afterimage anchors are evaluated separately in each block and never collapsed into an old four-factor design.
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.interferenceRule: A block must pass both separate anchor gates. A later preflight observes all acquisition sources but supports a scientific estimand only for the selected block; cross-channel or cross-package cells require measured decision-changing interference.
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.staging: This stage moves only from exact source to cached path capacity. Identity-safe telemetry can follow; whole-run evidence requires comparable CRN cells and cannot use a channel-specific cohort.

identityPreflightIfAuthorised.unlockNull: Omitted/baseline exactly reproduces unlock list, path, RNG, policy and result on all 256 rows.
identityPreflightIfAuthorised.telemetryNull: Off exactly reproduces path, RNG, policy and result separately and jointly with unlock null.
identityPreflightIfAuthorised.enabledUnlock: Adds exactly card:novaflare and card:emberdance through the existing spendthrift tier-pool path; no source-specific forced offer exists.
identityPreflightIfAuthorised.enabledTelemetry: Observes offer source, offered IDs and prices, acquisition source, draw, play, pre-play Embers, computed damage and Flare ordering without RNG or state mutation.

baseline.name: current-main root-551 Duskblade Vow-5 natural reward/economy rectangle

traceEvidence.name: identity-proved explicit-current arm from the Momentum preference CRN rectangle
traceEvidence.identityRule: Every current row exactly equals its cached baseline path, RNG, policy and result after trace/label fields are removed before any channel or outcome count is read.

cohort.identity: Both blocks, viability and both shared anchors reuse the exact complete first-look rectangle. No policy or seed is added, removed, selected or replaced.

scoreline.definition: At least two of four rows play Chisel before a later Faultline in the same fight.

afterimage.definition: At least two of four rows record positive Afterimage Guard damage.

estimands.unit: Frozen policy identity with a two-of-four robustness rule.
estimands.primary: Separate exact selector, potential-active, inactive and ambiguous policy sets for shop and event acquisition upper capacity.
estimands.viability: Exact potential-active policies with at least one winning frozen row containing the block's opportunity.
estimands.separation: Separate candidate-only, anchor-only, cross-active and Jaccard statistics against Scoreline and Afterimage within each block.
estimands.sourceCompleteness: Exact arbitrary-card acquisition channel inventory and exact absence of a Novaflare-specific combat-policy discriminator.
estimands.notEstimated: No realised Library/shop probability, offer, price, affordability, purchase order, acquisition, draw, play, Ember reserve, damage, causal payoff, RandomBuild, detector, protected seed or product endpoint is estimated.

estimator.method: Deterministic exact-source card-score translation, source-defined optimistic selectors, immutable path opportunity and exact policy-set arithmetic.
estimator.model: None. No bootstrap, fitted model, optimiser, ML or RL component is used.
estimator.firstLook: One exhaustive channel inventory, two frozen source predicates, one immutable cohort and one complete first look. No price, rank, threshold, block, anchor or cohort changes after counts are visible.
estimator.stopping: Freeze the first passing block in the preregistered order for identity preflight; close the complete family if neither passes; record inconclusive at the numeric cap.

gates.provenance: The 16 active/inactive and eight viability/two-sided-separation minima reuse the frozen 64-policy scale. The 0.75 ceiling and one immutable fault are unchanged. Each block must pass Scoreline and Afterimage separately.

decisionRules.success: At least one complete block passes selector, opportunity, active, inactive, viability, separate anchor and reliability gates.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Freeze Novaflare and only the first passing block in selectionOrder for the one natural-unlock/source-labelled telemetry identity preflight. Prove both nulls separately and jointly on all 256 rows. Do not execute an enabled unlock row, isolate a channel by changing product semantics, add a producer or vary a payoff.
decisionRules.futility: Neither complete acquisition block passes every frozen gate.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close deed-unlocked Ember-reserve damage and proceed inside issue #421 to preregister the smallest new deterministic Dusk-only structural primitive. Do not tune Novaflare, invent a combat threshold, add Tithe/Pyreheart, reopen the failed reward route or run another existing-grammar acquisition iteration.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Source completeness, immutable identity, deterministic score translation or both block decisions cannot complete before the wall-time cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record the inconclusive result at the cap without implementation, simulator spend, another selector, ML/RL or protected seeds.

methodBoundary: Deterministic Python owns channel construction, card scoring, cache validation, classification and stop/go. #524/#525 appear only through already-published immutable #421 decisions. No model context, human label, optimiser or adaptive candidate iteration enters execution.
